_MP SER GA_BA CAESAR AV_ ; DIVA AUGUSTA

Roman silver denarius of Emperor Galba ( AD 68-69). Obverse - inscription _MP SER GA_BA CAESAR AV_. description: laureate head right. inscription: DIVA AUGUSTA. description: Livia standing left holding scepter & patera. thickness:1.88mm, diamter: 18.96mm, weight: 3.12g
